enunciado:
Three travelers park at charging points. There are 3 positions numbered 1 to 3 from left to right. Each position has exactly one item from each list, and each listed item appears once. Travelers: Lea, Omar, Rui. Car colors: Copper, Indigo, Silver.
1. Omar is next to Rui.
2. Lea is somewhere to the left of Omar.
3. Omar is somewhere to the left of Rui.
4. Indigo is at the same position as Rui.
5. Silver is somewhere to the left of Copper.
For every listed item, give its position number.
verificacion_manual: El orden Lea, Omar, Rui ocupa de izquierda a derecha las tres posiciones. Indigo queda en 3 junto a Rui. El orden Silver–Copper llena 1 y 2.
fuente: Inventado para el HW2 con asistencia de Codex (ver AI_LOG.md).
